lot like a reindeer. And those lights are Christmas lights. Grab your ugly
sweater, fasten your red nose, and come help us kick off the holiday season as
early as we were allowed to at the Elks Temple Holiday Brewfest. Is it too
early? No! This event will feature holiday ales and ciders from around the
Northwest, live music, reindeer games and other festive libations as we dive into the holiday season in style.

About 80s kids 2
"HOLY JOHN HUGHES THAT WAS SO MUCH FUN!!!"
Get ready to turn up the nostalgia and sing your heart out! Synthpop sweethearts Shannon Curtis and Jamie Hill are returning to Tacoma with 80s kids 2 - the second installment of their breakout national hit show 80s kids.
80s kids 2 - lovingly referred to by those in the know as "80s kids 2: The Empire Strikes Back" - is a high-octane joyride through the best of 1980s synthpop - tied together with funny, moving stories about growing up in the 80s.
From the electrifying beats of Pet Shop Boys and New Order to the heart-on-the-sleeve melodies of OMD and Erasure, this show is a love letter to the decade of iconic anthems and underdog heroes.
This dynamic concert-style theater show features all-time favorites from Thompson Twins, Soft Cell, Alphaville, Naked Eyes, The Human League, and many more - delivered in a wildly fun and interactive performance that feels like youre experiencing them live for the first time.
With awesome, era-authentic sound, amazing immersive video art, killer merch, inclusive energy, and magnetic, joyful stage presence, 80s kids is an experience that you absolutely dont want to miss!
* Freebies at the merch table for people wearing 80s fashion!

About 90s Rewind
For the absolute best 90s pop-rock performing tribute band in the Pacific Northwest, youve come to the right place. 90s Rewind plays the songs that you probably remember listening to in between bites of 3D Doritos and sips of Surge... or maybe Zima... depending on your age or how good you were at sneaking alcohol past your parents. We focus on those tunes with great rhythmic beats to get butts out on the dance floor, melodic riffs that defined the era and memorable lyrics that make you go "Ohhhh I remember this song!" Our musical selection is uptempo to keep your evening bumpin - our main focus is that you have an amazing, memorable, 90s-fueled time!

From the producers of the hit ’60s Flashback Show comes A Very Merry Christmas Show — a spectacular, all-new holiday celebration filled with music, memories and Christmas magic!
Featuring more than 20 of the Northwest’s favorite vocalists and an incredible cast of dancers, A Very Merry Christmas Show takes audiences on an unforgettable journey through Christmas past to present — from the beloved songs and traditions of the 1940s and ’50s, through the unforgettable Christmas television specials of the ’60s and ’70s, and all the way to the holiday favorites we love today.
Expect soaring vocals, show-stopping dance numbers, dazzling costumes, heartwarming nostalgia and treasured memories of Christmases gone by — all brought to life in the same high-energy, nostalgic style audiences loved in ’60s Flashback.
After sold-out performances in Seattle, this much-loved holiday production is coming south for one special night at the Federal Way Performing Arts & Events Center.
And the magic doesn’t end when the curtain comes down! Santa Claus will be waiting in the lobby after the show to meet the kids, making this a Christmas memory the whole family can share.
This year, A Very Merry Christmas Show is also proud to partner with local charity PB&J for the Homeless. Guests are invited to join in the spirit of giving by bringing a jar of peanut butter or jelly to donate in the lobby on the night of the performance.
Kick-start your Christmas spirit with an unforgettable night of music, dancing, laughter, nostalgia and holiday magic for the whole family.
And be ready for a magical finale you won’t soon forget.

About About You
After years of receiving stories from friends, fans, and total strangers, About You has adapted these stories into songs found on their debut album. Outfitting themselves with old guitars, 808s, and a rich study of music, About You is forging a musical path all their own to bring these stories to you. Los Angeles-based indie rock 5-piece led by Max Poscente, About You is a 2x winner of the International Songwriting Competition, surpassed 2.3M+ streams across platforms, sold out shows covering the US (Los Angeles, New York, Chicago, and Dallas), and has received international press (New Noise, Earmilk, Ones to Watch, Louder Than War, NBC, etc.).
About Collin Salcido
Collin Salcido is an American indie/alt rock artist based in Seattle Washington focused on introspective lyrics and capturing his emotions through dynamic and layered instrumentation Collins music encapsulates the feelings of heartbreak, anger, love, and loss from past experiences in his life.
About The Remainders
In the time before the pandemic, there were five. In the aftermath, three remained. Nobody died, they just couldnt hang. Like a phoenix from the ashes, the three REMAINDERS rose. They took their 60s pop and 90s alt  and channeled them through synthesizers and drum machines to become what  see before you. These sonic alchemists met in university - Michael and Ryan have degrees in music, but Cosmos degree is in math because hes a nerd. Over the years they have played at a variety of venues across Washington State, including Chateau Ste. Michelle, The Columbia City Theater, High Dive, Chop Suey, and El Corazon. Their music was also featured in the film "The Space Between" (2017) and were invited to play at the Carmel International Film Festival for the films debut. Remainders discography includes a six track EP, with more on the way.

Fans of the internationally renowned Irish music phenomenon,
Celtic Thunder
, are in for a special treat as the group continues and expands on their successful show,
An Evening with Celtic Thunder

An Evening with Celtic Thunder
is more than just a concert—it’s a journey through the group’s incredible legacy. Featuring a carefully curated setlist of their greatest hits, this show will showcase the powerful harmonies, soaring ballads, and electrifying performances that have made Celtic Thunder a household name. From classic Irish folk songs to contemporary favorites, audiences can expect to hear the anthems that have defined Celtic Thunder’s illustrious career.
What makes this show even more special is the reunion of familiar faces. Over the years, Celtic Thunder has been home to some of the finest vocalists in the world, and
An Evening with Celtic Thunder
will see Emmet, Damian, Neil and Ronan perform some of Celtic Thunder’s greatest songs. Longtime fans will be thrilled to see their favorite voices come together, blending their talents in an atmosphere of warmth and nostalgia.
“We wanted to create something truly special for our fans, something that feels personal and celebratory,” says Damian McGinty, longtime Celtic Thunder Principal. “This show is about reconnecting—with the music, with each other, and with the people who have supported us throughout the years. It’s a chance to relive the magic of Celtic Thunder in a more intimate way, and we couldn’t be more excited to share this experience with our audience.”
Since its inception, Celtic Thunder has captivated global audiences with its stunning performances and rich musical heritage. Known for their dynamic stage presence and ability to blend traditional Irish music with contemporary sounds, the group has sold millions of albums and performed on some of the world’s most prestigious stages.
Formed in Dublin in 2007, Celtic Thunder is a multi-dimensional musical and theatrical ensemble celebrated worldwide for their emotionally powerful performances and state-of-the-art productions. Billboard Magazine has named them the Top World Album Artist five times, and their albums consistently rank in the World Album Top 10.

big_desc:
Auburn Symphony Orchestra: Rhythm & Revelry - Performing Arts and Event Center

Auburn Symphony Orchestra: Rhythm & Revelry
2:30 pm
May 02 2027
Tickets
A season finale is a celebration.
Rhythm & Revelry begins with sacred joy in Omar Thomas’ Come Sunday, a tribute to the Hammond organ’s central place in Black worship. The first movement, “Testimony,” prepares the spirit with a sound world shaped by Bach, blues, jazz, and R&B. The second, “Shout!,” bursts into the ecstatic moment when celebration takes over. Thomas writes with love, energy, and purpose, honoring Black culture through music that sings, moves, and lifts the room.
From there, the spotlight turns to violinist Nathan Amaral in Tchaikovsky’s Violin Concerto. Born in Rio de Janeiro, Amaral began violin through a social project in Mangueira and has since become one of the most compelling young violinists on the international stage. He won First Prize at the 2024 Sphinx Competition and the Grand Prize of the 2024 CAG-YCAT Competitions, and Yo-Yo Ma has praised his rare ability to move beyond technique into the heart of musical expression. Tchaikovsky’s concerto gives him a perfect canvas: soaring melodies, dazzling passagework, and emotional sweep from first note to last.
Then Auburn Symphony takes center stage. Ravel’s Boléro begins with a single rhythm and one unforgettable theme, repeating again and again as the music grows from a whisper to a blaze. Each section of the orchestra gets its moment to shine, turning one simple idea into a thrilling display of color and control.
Strauss’ Der Rosenkavalier Suite brings the afternoon to a lavish close. Drawn from his beloved opera, the suite mixes romantic sweep with elegant waltzes and the glittering richness of Vienna imagined through Strauss’ 20th-century orchestral voice.
From worship to virtuosity to full-orchestra spectacle, Rhythm & Revelry sends the season out with brilliance, abundance, and joy.

title: Auburn Symphony Orchestra: Symphonic Stories
big_desc:
Auburn Symphony Orchestra: Symphonic Stories - Performing Arts and Event Center

Auburn Symphony Orchestra: Symphonic Stories
2:30 pm
Apr 04 2027
Tickets
Some forces are invisible, but you feel their pull.
Symphonic Stories brings together three works about distance, memory, imagination, and the stories that hold us together. A voice reaches across grief. A soloist moves through shifting celestial worlds. A woman tells story after story, surviving one night at a time.
Jennifer Higdon’s blue cathedral begins the journey in a place of remembrance. Written after the death of her brother, Andrew Blue Higdon, the piece imagines a vast sacred space filled with light, crystal, and upward motion. The flute, Higdon’s instrument, and the clarinet, her brother’s instrument, move through the music like two voices reaching toward one another. It is a work of loss, but also of release: a quiet ascent through memory toward something larger.
From there, Auburn Symphony looks outward with the Co-Commission of Gravity at a Distance, a new saxophone concerto by Viet Cuong written for Timothy McAllister. The concerto takes inspiration from celestial bodies and the unseen forces that bind them across immense distances. The solo saxophone moves through orchestral worlds that feel luminous, floating, dense, and immense, tracing a path between isolation and attraction, stillness and motion.
Then comes one of music’s great storytellers. Rimsky-Korsakov’s Scheherazade draws from One Thousand and One Nights, where Scheherazade survives a violent ruler not through force, but through intelligence, wit, and imagination. Each night, she tells a story compelling enough to earn another dawn. In the orchestra, her voice returns through the solo violin: persuasive, resilient, and unbroken.
With blue cathedral, Gravity at a Distance, and Scheherazade, Symphonic Stories becomes a concert about what connects us across silence, space, and danger. These are stories of remembrance, invention, and survival, told in the language of the orchestra.

A girl takes flight on a broomstick. A forest spirit waits beneath the trees. A young girl wanders into a bathhouse for gods. A castle lumbers across the hills on impossible legs.
For generations of fans, Studio Ghibli has created animated films that feel both fantastical and deeply human. Founded in Japan and closely associated with filmmaker Hayao Miyazaki, the studio has become one of the most beloved names in animation, with stories known for wonder, adventure, environmental beauty, and characters who find courage in unfamiliar worlds.
At the heart of many of those films is the music of Joe Hisaishi. His scores do more than accompany the action. They give these worlds their breath, motion, and emotional pull. Like John Williams’ long partnership with Steven Spielberg, Hisaishi’s music has helped shape the identity of the films themselves.
Led by Music Director Wesley Schulz, Auburn Symphony celebrates the music of Kiki’s Delivery Service, My Neighbor Totoro, Spirited Away, and Howl’s Moving Castle in a concert filled with soaring melodies, playful characters, sweeping orchestral color, and moments of quiet beauty. Fans will recognize the themes they love. New listeners will hear why this music has reached far beyond the screen.
The Music of Studio Ghibli is a concert for families, anime fans, film lovers, and anyone ready for an evening of adventure, nostalgia, and imagination.

About Babes in Canyon
Eloquently blending synth-folk, moody pop, club beats, and soaring vocal harmonies, Babes In Canyon crafts music that is eminently engaging and very much of the moment. Born of a spontaneous writing session during a winter storm blackout, the band wandered naturally into the land of heavy beats, lyrics with an element of storytelling, and synth-folk instrumentation with a twist. Lush and astutely layered, what began as an exploration of the outer edges of Americana has evolved into a cohesive, enchanting artistic statement. With a spate of national tours, festivals, and live performances under their belt, songwriters Nathan and Sophia Hamer conjure up layered soundscapes, "looping keys, beats, percussion effortlessly in an electric, raucous live performance" (Atwood Magazine). Receiving praise from the likes of Under The Radar, Magnet, and Big Takeover, Babes In Canyons debut album "The New Loud" released in the fall of 2025. Genre-defying, expertly arranged, and profoundly catchy, Babes In Canyon stands ready to soundtrack your adventures - spontaneous or otherwise.
About Anna Smyrk
Anna Smyrk is a powerful singer and songmaker from Naarm (Melbourne, Australia). Her anthemic indie songs pair vulnerable lyrics with explosive arrangements and undeniable hooks. Anna Smyrks new album is all these things. Her first full length record, out now, dives deep into holding joy and pain together; a mix of comfort, sadness, and emotional release. Debuting #20 on the US specialty radio charts, #20 on the ARIA charts for Australia albums and getting multiple spins on BBC Radio, this is a release to watch. It showcases exceptional songwriting, driving indie-rock sounds, sweet alt-folk confessions, heart-wrenching lyrics and Annas delicate yet powerful vocals, described as "truly astonishing" by Rolling Stone.
Website:
https://blackoakartists.com/artist/anna-smyrk/
About Shelby Natasha
Shelby Natasha is a Seattle-based songwriter and music producer whose sound blends alt-R&B and Chinese folk music. Influenced by her upbringing between China and the Pacific Northwest, her ethereal vocals are accompanied by the traditional Chinese instrument, Guzheng, and layered over lo-fi beats. Shelbys performance career began with Sofar Sounds, where she has played over 100 shows across the United States, and she has gone on to perform at festivals and venues across the country such as Belltown Bloom (May 2024), Oregon Country Fair (2025), Portland Folk Fest (2025), Northwest Folklife (2025), Any Patch of Grass (2025),  Imagine Festival (2025), Doe Bay Artist in Residence (Aug 2024).  She has also played support slots for East Forest @ St Marks Cathedral and Simrit @ TOC.

About CODA (Led Zeppelin tribute)
CODA is a Led Zeppelin tribute super group with a cast of (7) world class musicians.  This All Star cast come together in recreating the eternal epic sounds of the original studio recordings from the greatest rock & roll band in the worlds history with a full 7-piece ensemble of career A-list musicians that deliver the most authentic, transformative audible experience since Led Zeppelin played their last concert in 2007 @ Londons O2 Arena.
CODA transcends an art form that was created 50 years ago now played live by pitch perfect Susan Kendall lead vocals, drummer Jeff Kathan who could be John Bonhams own descendant, shredding lead guitarist Manuel Morais, keyboards & vocalist Joe Carolus, Dirk Leuenberger rhythm, lead and 12-string guitars, virtuoso bassist Todd Gowers, and Stephanie Smithlin harmony vocals , all culminating in a sonic explosion that would make Jimmy Page proud if he were seated beside you.
CODAs exhilarating show is best described as re-living Led Zeppelin as it was first written & produced and the way it is now meant to be - spanning a 3.5 hour library of songs from every album that every Led Zeppelin fan holds near and dear to their own musical life history.  The musicality of Led Zeppelin combined with rich texturing, diversity and the bandwidth of emotions recreated by CODA is unsurpassed in the world of tribute bands.  CODA is Led Zeppelin 2.0 - dont miss the opportunity to enjoy an evening with Led Zeppelin deservedly honored as the greatest rock music band in recorded history.

About Candi Carpenter and Moselle
Join Candi Carpenter and Moselle for an evening of indie and alternative pop music celebrating Candis latest EP, Biblically Accurate Angel, and Moselles forthcoming album, Gargoyle. Through powerhouse vocals and fearless storytelling, both artists explore themes of toxic religion, trauma, identity, and self-discovery with equal parts vulnerability, humor, and heart. Expect an unforgettable evening of cathartic songs, intimate moments, and dynamic performances that invite audiences to laugh, heal, and celebrate the beautifully messy human experience.
About Candi Carpenter
Candi Carpenter is a 5,665 year old extraterrestrial vampire space witch AND recording artist.
Even though they’ve had plenty of time to find fame and fortune, it’s still just THAT hard to be an
independent artist.
In 2024, Carpenter released their Alt-Pop debut,
Demonology
, a full-length album produced by
Carpenter, Peter Shurkin, and Alden Witt, described as a “powerfully raw listen” by
Maximum
Volume Music
. Carpenter’s passionate, self-examining songs center around highly personal
stories of growing up in the Midwest and leaving Christianity.
Carpenter has attracted collaborations with artists including Brandy Carlile, and praise from
publications like
Rolling Stone
, calling Carpenter “a devastatingly direct singer with… an axe to
grind;” while
To The Point Music
states, “Candi Carpenter is one of those once in a lifetime
talents.”
Demonology
has garnered millions of views on social media, along with being featured on
Spotify’s “New Pop Picks,” “Fresh Finds Pop,” Tidal’s “Rising Pop,” Amazon Music’s “Fresh
Pop,” “Acoustic Pop,” and “Breakthrough Pop” and SiriusXM Hitbound and many others.
Carpenter is currently recording and touring in Summer 2024.
About Moselle
Growing up in the Ozarks of Arkansas, Moselle was in proximity to nature that inspired both awe and fear. Dualities like this were early inspirations and continue to shape their writing even now while based in Los Angeles. Described as a "musical force" due to their knack for cramming witty, introspective lyrics into unique and bewitching melodies, Moselle delivers songs with a powerful, lilting voice often compared to that of Alanis Morissette & Delores ORiordan
About Jody Ellen
Jody Ellen is a pop/alt rock singer and songwriter whose music blends heartfelt piano ballads with powerful rock anthems, drawing comparisons to artists like Evanescence, Paramore, and Lana Del Rey. Known for her earworm melodies, layered harmonies, and emotionally charged lyrics, she embodies a dynamic mix of vulnerability and strength in both her music and style. With a modern twist on 60s bombshell glam, Jodys duality shines through in her music, which shifts from soft to hard, while her fun and approachable personality makes her relatable to fans. Fiercely authentic yet accessible, Jody continues to carve out her place as a versatile rising star in the pop/rock scene.

Carl & Wes is a country/rock band from Tumwater, Washington. Originally started as a duo between two middle school friends, has now turned into a full 5 piece band. About Chewing Gum
Chewing Gum is an all-girl heavy grunge band in Seattle. Formed in 2025, Chewing Gums goal is to revive the raw sound of the 90s while bringing fresh, female fronted energy to new audiences. They draw inspiration from Alice in Chains, Rage Against the Machine, Hole and other high energy bands. In the words of lead singer Maddie Meharry, "Girls can rock out just as hard as all the f***ng guys." Chewing Gum brings feminine flair to hard, sludgy rock. Known for their high energy and unpredictable live performances, Chewing Gum aims to make people feel something, whether through music or live.
About Social Etiquette
Social Etiquette blends heavy, melodic rock with influences from various
genres and styles. creating a sound thats both powerful and dynamic. Fronted
by vocalist Jordyn Renee, the band is rounded out by Nathon on drums, Cohbie on
rhythm guitar, Jonah on lead guitar, and Zan on bass. Together, they deliver
hard hitting songs driven by emotion, energy, and a passion for making music
that connects.
About Discernment
Discernment is a three-piece alternative rock/punk band from Tacoma and Bonney Lake, Washington. Formed in March 2026, the band blends simple but heavy guitar riffs with emotionally driven songwriting, drawing influence from artists like Alice in Chains, Nirvana, Silverchair, Hum, and Tool. Their music balances raw energy with meaningful lyrics, creating songs that are both powerful and personal.
Known for emotional, high-energy live performances, Discernment aims to create an experience that people can connect with long after the show ends. With their debut single currently in the final stages of mixing, the band is focused on releasing new music, growing their audience, and playing as many live shows as possible.

About Critical Mass Big Band and Sugartime Trio
Critical Mass Big Band and Sugartime Trio unite powerhouse instrumentation with dazzling vocal harmonies to create an unforgettable live music experience.  For nearly 25 years, Critical Mass Big Band has stood as a cornerstone of contemporary jazz in the Pacific Northwest, captivating audiences with electrifying performances and a rich, full-bodied sound. Featuring an expansive lineup of saxophones, trombones, trumpets, and a driving rhythm section, the ensemble delivers high-energy big band jazz with precision, passion, and undeniable swing.
Sugartime Trio, joining forces with this dynamic orchestra, adds a fresh and stylish vocal dimension. Since 2016, this acclaimed female jazz/pop ensemble has charmed audiences with their tight three-part harmonies, blending hot swing with lush ballads. Their repertoire spans from the golden age of the 1930s to modern favorites, all delivered with a signature blend of sophistication, charisma, and polish.
Together, these standout acts create a vibrant fusion of classic big band power and sleek vocal artistry-offering audiences a timeless yet contemporary musical experience that is as exhilarating as it is truly unforgettable.

Country music icon Dwight Yoakam is bringing his unmistakable sound live to the EQC Event Center on Saturday, November 14 along with support from Wynn Williams.
For four decades, Yoakam has helped define a distinctive brand of honky-tonk and country music, earning two GRAMMY Awards and 18 nominations along the way. From the unmistakable swagger of “Guitars, Cadillacs” and “Honky Tonk Man” to fan favorites like “Streets of Bakersfield,” “A Thousand Miles from Nowhere,” “Fast as You” and “Ain’t That Lonely Yet,” his catalog is packed with songs that have become country classics.
Yoakam has recorded more than twenty albums and compilations, charted more than thirty singles on the Billboard Hot Country Songs charts, and sold more than 25 million records. Five of his albums were Billboard No. 1s, twelve went gold, and nine platinum, including the triple-platinum This Time. He pushed the boundaries of what was considered “country,” attracting roots rock fans and college audiences. In the ‘90s, he turned his attention to the big screen, notably in critically-acclaimed performances as “bad guys” in Sling Blade and Panic Room – both stretches for mellow Yoakam, who has been described as one of the industry’s true “good guys.” He continues to produce and write well-received albums and songs, and to act for television and film.Now, experience that legendary voice, signature style and Bakersfield-inspired sound live in Tacoma. Tacoma Operas production brings together powerful voices, dramatic staging, and the rich sound of a live orchestra to create an immersive evening of musical storytelling. The Pantages Theater—one of the Pacific Northwests most treasured historic venues—provides the perfect backdrop for an opera of this scale and emotional depth.
Tickets are expected to move quickly for this limited two-performance run. Dont miss your chance to be part of a truly epic night of opera in Tacoma. Secure your seats today and prepare to be swept away by the passion, power, and mythology of Die Walküre.

This intrigued it, it hadnt been drawn to anything ever since it was anthropomorphized from just an idea.  One of the ultimate ideas but an idea none the less.  Seeing the effect that music had on the souls of the people it touched the Reaper felt that this would be the most opposite of what it had been doing. The Reaper decided to start a band.
However, it didnt know what it was doing. So, it sought people who did. First it needed someone to write songs, and he found that in Tarantula Jones.  Tarantula already wanting to be a writer and having a small amount of talent for guitar.  He was smart, but he was also still very childish in a lot of ways. Tarantula was easy to tempt with promises of comic books.
Next, he knew he needed a solid rhythm section, and not just any would do. He needed someone different someone crazy.  He needed Pandamonium, hailing from the land of SoCal punk and bringing a spice to the drums that added a little extra rhythm, there was no other choice.  This one was by far the most difficult to get but eventually a deal was made over tacos and drinks.
While the easiest member to convince was the bass player, he was also the most difficult to find.  A southern transplant Smokestack continued to travel North led by the smell of some super skunk.  It is rumored that he was the one that found the Reaper and made the offer to join the band in exchange for some of his killer weed.
With the band formed it was time to figure out what kind of music they would play. Everyone had different influences, but they all agreed on Punk as being the main style they all agreed on.  With that set they started adding and blending all of their influences to play whatever they want.  However, the Reaper wasnt prepared for what he had created and the forces it took to bring everyone together.  He was now just as stuck as they were in these deals.  This is how the 4 piece punk band, Reaper PunX, from Tacoma Washington came to be."
About Velvet Tang
Velvet Tang plays rock & roll with a punk rock intensity fueled by powerful vocals, soaring guitar harmonies, and a rhythm section that hits with precision and intensity. Blending classic hard rock influences with a modern edge, the band brings an authentic, no nonsense approach to every performance, creating a show that keeps audiences engaged from the first note to the last. Fronted by dynamic vocalist Sean Galvin, Velvet Tangs sound is driven by the dual-guitar attack of Mike Corvin and Jeffrey Smith, whose riffs and melodic leads create the bands signature sonic punch. Holding down the low end is bassist Dave Hickey, while drummer Dave "Sketty" Hendrickson provides the powerhouse beats that anchor every song. Whether performing crowd-favorite punk rock anthems or delivering original material, Velvet Tang is committed to bringing passion, professionalism, and unforgettable live performances to every stage they play.
Band Members
• Sean Galvin - Vocals
• Mike Corvin - Guitar
• Jeffrey Smith - Guitar
• Dave Hickey - Bass
• Dave "Sketty" Hendrickson - Drums
Velvet Tang isnt just another rock band, theyre a live experience built on musicianship, energy, and a shared love of great rock music.
About DROPtheSTAR
DROPtheSTAR is an American-made rock band built on loud guitars, big hooks, raw emotion, and a healthy disregard for the ordinary.
Blending the grit of grunge, the attitude of hard rock, and the timeless power of classic rock, DROPtheSTAR creates music that feels both familiar and completely its own. Their songs are unapologetic, honest, and driven by the kind of riffs that hit you in the chest and choruses that demand to be shouted back.
The bands world exists somewhere between a dark curiosity shop and a smoky rock club-a place where strange things live, stories have teeth, and nothing is quite what it seems. Their visual identity is as unconventional as their music, filled with mystery, symbolism, rebellion, and a little bit of beautiful chaos.
At the heart of DROPtheSTAR is a simple idea: music should make you feel something.
They write about fighting for what matters, surviving what tries to break you, questioning what were told, and finding something worth believing in when the world gets loud.
No major-label machine. No massive advertising budget. No manufactured image.
Just four musicians, their instruments, their stories, and a determination to make something real.
DROPtheSTAR - American Made. Rock & Roll. Nothing Ordinary.

Frequently Asked Questions
Question
Answer
Do I need a ticket for my dog?
Yes. Each dog requires a $20 dog ticket, which includes admission to the zoo for the dog for specified areas and exhibits. Dog tickets are required for both members and non-members. Your ticket will indicate the earliest time you can enter the zoo. You must enter the zoo within one hour of that time. Once inside, you can stay until closing. There are a limited number of dog tickets available per day, so be sure to get yours before they sell out. Dog Days is a rain-or-shine event, and tickets are non-refundable.
Can I buy a dog ticket at the gate?
No. Dog tickets must be purchased online in advance. Walk-up dog tickets are not available.
Do I need a regular Zoo ticket too?
Yes. All human guests must purchase standard Zoo admission or be current Zoo members.
How old must dog handlers be?
All dog handlers must be 18 years or older and able to control the dog at all times.
Are there leash, collar, health, or behavior requirements?
Yes. All dogs must: be on a non-retractable leash no longer than 6 feet, be well-behaved and non-aggressive, be current on vaccinations. Prong, choke, spike or heavy chain collars are NOT allowed. Collar must include an identification tag with owners contact information.
Do I need to complete a waiver?
Yes. During online registration, all dog owners will be required to complete a waiver. By completing the waiver, you are confirming that the dog you bring meets all vaccination, health, and behavior requirements.
Dogs must be friendly toward people and other dogs, remain under your control at all times, and not exhibit aggressive or disruptive behavior.
How many dogs can I bring?
There is a limit of one dog per adult guest for safety reasons.
Where can I bring my dog inside the zoo?
Dogs are welcome in designated dog-friendly areas, including both aquariums, lawn spaces, and restrooms. Note: Certain areas will be off-limits to dogs, including goats, puffins, and the Wild Wonders Outdoor Theater. Download the map to see where dogs are welcome.
Can my dog ride on the carousel?
No. Dogs are not allowed on the carousel. They are welcome into the carousel building, but may not ride.
Am I responsible for cleaning up after my dog?
Yes, all owners are required to pick up after their pets at all times.
Are there water stations for dogs?
Absolutely. We’ll have multiple communal water bowls located throughout the zoo.
Are service animals allowed at the Zoo on non-Dog Days?
Yes. Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium welcomes guests with disabilities who use service animals as determined by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and Washington Administrative Code. Guests using service animals are required to check-in at the admission window where you’ll be provided with information to plan your visit to our facilities.
Who can I contact for more information?
You may send an email to: comments@pdza.org with further questions.

Yes. During online registration, all dog owners will be required to complete a waiver. By completing the waiver, you are confirming that the dog you bring meets all vaccination, health, and behavior requirements. Dogs must be friendly toward people and other dogs, remain under your control at all times, and not exhibit aggressive or disruptive behavior.
How many dogs can I bring?
There is a limit of one dog per adult guest for safety reasons.
Where can I bring my dog inside the zoo?
Dogs are welcome in designated dog-friendly areas, including the gift shop and restrooms. Dogs are not permitted to enter the cafe, but a walk-up window is available for food purchases. Note: Certain areas will be off-limits to dogs.
Can my dog ride on the carousel?
No. Dogs are not allowed on the carousel. They are welcome into the carousel building, but may not ride.
Am I responsible for cleaning up after my dog?
Yes, all owners are required to pick up after their pets at all times.
Are there water stations for dogs?
Absolutely. We’ll have multiple communal water bowls located throughout the zoo.
Are service animals allowed at the Zoo on non-Dog Days?
Yes. Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium welcomes guests with disabilities who use service animals as determined by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and Washington Administrative Code. Guests using service animals are required to check-in at the admission window where you’ll be provided with information to plan your visit to our facilities.
Who can I contact for more information?
You may send an email to: comments@pdza.org with further questions.
Dog Nights tickets include admission for one dog and one adult. There are a limited number of dog tickets, so get yours early! Tickets must be purchased online. No Dog Night tickets will be sold at the front gate.

About Federale
Founded in 2004, Federale has released seven cinematic
records inspired by obscure spaghetti westerns, folk-based murder ballads, 60s
and 70s European soundtracks, and stylishly dramatic vocalists such as Lee
Hazelwood and Nick Cave. Federales music has appeared in films, including
A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night
,
The Bad Batch
, and
The Lego Movie
, while the band has toured extensively throughout North
America and Europe.
Federales newest album
Love & Other Lies
(2026) teems with a dark sentimentality and a
pronounced gloomy sensibility drawing from British new wave, post-punk, goth,
and 1960s rock n roll. Strains of The Cure, Depeche Mode, The Sisters of
Mercy, Siouxsie and the Banshees, Tears for Fears, and even The Beatles abound.
Here, lead singer and primary songwriter Collin Hegnas emotive baritone is
swathed in period-perfect Prophet-5 synthesizers and glistening counter-melody guitar
lines, and supported by intricate but lyrical
basslines and coldly mechanical drums.
Love & Other
Lies
picks up where Federales previous album,
Reverb & Seduction
, left off. That album was a radical departure
from the bands previous
releases which featured mostly instrumentals. "There are a lot more
similarities than you think," Hegna says of the groups seemingly two distinct
aesthetic periods. "When we were referencing the obscure influences, we liked the drama
and darkness. Those elements are in new wave, goth, and post-punk. I just
grabbed another couple of colors from the Crayon box."
Website:
http://federalepdx.com/
About Cockaphonix
Holiday Dan (drums) and Rayko Stanislav (piano) started a cacophony of curious clanging helter skelter sounds in 2017. Using a 100 year old upright Meister piano which has travelled across the west and a rickety Pearl drum set they were joined by equally dysfunctional horns: a thrift store tuba (Tubano), knock off Indian valve trombone (Tom Bone) and street find trumpet (Roly). Together they make (mostly) wordless sound eruptions that have only best been described as "if Danny Elfman and Eliot Smith had a baby and if fell down a spiral staircase in New Orleans"
Come try and describe the ear twisting music yourself! See ya on the asphalt!

Join fellow community members to give back to city parks and green spaces during the Green Tacoma Day. Having access to healthy parks and urban green spaces is vital to our quality of life.
The Green Tacoma Partnership invites people of all ages to get outside, have fun and engage in Tacoma’s natural areas. Volunteers will plant trees, remove invasive weeds, and provide a helping hand to our green spaces.
Tools, gloves, and instruction will be provided.

What should I bring?
Please dress in layers and in clothing that you don’t mind getting dirty.
Closed-toed shoes, long sleeves, and pants are recommended.
Don’t forget to bring your rain gear if rain is in the forecast.
Bring a full water bottle and snacks.

Saturday, October 10, 2026 | 9 am-12 pm at Franklin Park
Join Parks Tacoma at Senator Rosa Franklin Park for a morning of habitat restoration! Volunteers will be planting native species, spreading mulch, and removing invasive plants in the natural area of the park.
Click here to register
For questions, please contact Community and Special Projects Coordinator, Chloe Gronlund, at
chloe.gronlund@parkstacoma.gov.
Wapato Hills Restoration Work Party
Saturday, October 10, 2026 | 9 am-12 pm at Wapato Hills Park
Volunteer with us in the natural area of Wapato Hills Park, where we will care for the unique Oregon white oak prairie! Activities include removing weeds like scotch broom and non-native blackberry and spreading native prairie seeds. We will also share information about this rare habitat and the history of the site. This work supports water quality, our local wildlife, and the restoration of prairie oak habitat.
Click here to register
For questions, please contact Community and Special Projects Coordinator, Kevin Johnson, at
kevin.johnson@parkstacoma.gov.
What is the Green Tacoma Partnership?
The
Green Tacoma Partnership
, formed in 2005, is a collaborative effort between Green Tacoma Partnership members and partners including the City of Tacoma, Tacoma Tree Foundation, Pierce Conservation District, Parks Tacoma, University of Washington Tacoma, Clover Park Technical College, Washington State University, the Port of Tacoma, the Tahoma Bird Alliance, Pierce County Parks, and the South End Neighborhood Council, and hundreds of volunteers to restore and maintain our forested parks and open spaces.
Through this program, Green Tacoma partners with local communities to recruit, train, and support volunteer stewards to lead forest restoration projects in priority parks. The city and its partners aim to build a strong culture of community stewardship, leadership, and partnership to support a healthy urban forest for everyone.

Event Details
Stunning audiences throughout North America and Europe and making them ask, “Is this real?”, the duo is set to prove it with their latest tour. The live show, which has been called “hilarious and fascinating” by Time Out New York, combines hypnosis and improv for a one-of-a-kind comedy experience. “We are so excited to launch this new tour and return to some of our favorite cities and visit some new ones," said Asad Mecci. “It’s been an incredible journey.”
“And we just want to remind everyone, YES! It’s real,” exclaims Colin Mochrie.
HYPROV has been acclaimed by prestigious publications, with The New York Times declaring, “The audience erupted in laughter." It killed." The Wall Street Journal praised it as “catnip for those who relish spontaneity and informality,” and The New Yorker advised, “Say yes to HYPROV.”
The 90-minute show combines hypnosis and improv—two art forms that have mystified and entertained fans, skeptics, and everyone in between. The evening begins with Mecci welcoming 20 volunteers on stage to be hypnotized. The most receptive to hypnosis then join Mochrie to improvise the rest of the show while hypnotized. In the hands of two experts and solely crafted from the volunteers’ and audiences uninhibited, unconscious minds, each show is an entirely original and completely unforgettable theatrical experience.
HYPROV was created in 2016 at Toronto’s Second City. After working it out on stage, they took the show on the road to Just for Laughs London, Just for Laughs Montreal, and the Edinburgh Fringe, where it was received with rave reviews in 2016 and 2017. The duo set out on a 100-city tour from 2019 to 2023, performed 12 weeks off-Broadway in NYC, six months at Harrah’s Las Vegas, and a 16-show residency at the CAA Theatre in Toronto.

About Joe Pug
A singer-songwriter known for his lyrical acumen and plaintive harmonica style, Joe Pug dropped out of college and moved to Chicago where he worked as a carpenter before breaking into the citys music scene. Since 2008 he has released a string of critically-acclaimed albums and toured heavily in the U.S. and abroad. Paste Magazine wrote of his music: "Unless your surname is Dylan, Waits, Ritter or Prine, you could face-palm yourself to death trying to pen songs half as inspired."
He has toured with Steve Earle, Levon Helm, The Killers, Justin Townes Earle, Sturgill Simpson, and many others. He has appeared at Lollapalooza, Bonnaroo, and The Newport Folk Festival. His music has appeared on NPRs "Prairie Home Companion" and "Mountain Stage". His music has been released by Lightning Rod Records, which features an alumni roster of Jason Isbell, Billy Joe Shaver, and James McMurtry.
Additionally, he is the creator and host of the popular podcast The Working Songwriter.

About Matt Hansen - The Orchid Tour
LA-based singer-songwriter Matt Hansen has quickly emerged
as one of todays most captivating voices. Without a record label, he has
independently built a devoted global following with his powerhouse vocals and
emotionally charged songwriting, first connecting with fans on TikTok, where he
now has over 3 million followers, before breaking out with original music that
has amassed more than 1 billion streams worldwide. His recently released debut
album
Orchid
marks
his most personal project to date, an exceptionally raw body of work that
navigates love, loss, and hope, bringing together the hits that fueled his
independent rise, including "something to remember" "yellowstone," and "LET EM
GO." By turning lifes most vulnerable moments into deeply relatable songs,
Hansen has built a global community rooted in shared experience, reframing
vulnerability not as weakness, but as a powerful source of strength and
connection. That emotional honesty has translated into a rapidly growing live
presence, including headline tours across three continents, support slots with
Train, Teddy Swims, Lauv, and Alec Benjamin, and most recently, his national
television debut on The TODAY Show.

About Neko Case
Every handful of years, Neko Case resurfaces with a new album and reminds listeners that she is one of our greatest living songwriters - perpetually becoming more fearless and adventurous. "She has cultivated one of the most distinctive voices in American song," Stereogum declared. "Her albums unravel like musical picaresque: restlessly digressive, bluntly funny, strange - but never in ways youd anticipate."
The Grammy-nominated iconoclasts ninth LP, Neon Grey Midnight Green, is her biggest-sounding and most intimate-feeling album yet. Released last fall to immediate critical acclaim and declared an essential album in her catalog, the album was laid down live with a full band. More "in the room" than any of her past work, even breaths and shirt-sleeve rustlings were kept in the final mix as a reminder that "humans were here."
"There are so few producers who are women, nonbinary, or trans," says Case, who identifies as gender fluid and uses she/her pronouns. "People dont think of us as an option. Im proud to say I produced this record."
Today she is announcing a new run of Neon Grey Midnight Green tour dates that begin this fall on the East coast and end with two shows in Cases hometown of Tacoma, Washington.

About Girl Trouble
Tacoma, Washington
:
A town where hazardous waste and pulp mill fumes smelled like a breath of fresh
air, old buildings were being leveled in order to "revitalize" a
dying downtown, forests and farmlands were giving way to industrial parks and
shopping malls, a cultural event was wrestling at the Tacoma Dome, and
Girl Trouble
could be
found practicing with their plywood speaker cabinets and a drum set purchased
for $70 from the Sears surplus store in a shed beside Bon and Kahunas parents
house, where they still practice today.
With the minimal pounding of Bons drums, the steady cool of Dale on bass,
the buzzsaw scream from Kahunas Ouija guitar, and the rabid rock n roll
vocal stylings of
K
.P.
Kendall,
Girl Trouble
continues playing throughout the Northwest, 30-plus years on. So thats the
story, kids. Use it or lose it. Its my way or the highway. Eat it or wear it.

About Polyrhythmics
Funk-soul-R&B-jazz-Afrobeat
"For those whove ever wondered what Massive Attack would sound like doing bong hits with Miles Davis" -
The Georgia Straight
Seattle-based Polyrhythmics are celebrating 16 years of sonic exploration following the release of their latest album, Life from Below (2025). Since forming in 2010, this six piece powerhouse has redefined instrumental music with a sound that blends funk, soul, psychedelic rock, R&B, and Afrobeat into a kaleidoscope of rhythm and groove. Known for their dynamic live performances and innovative compositions, the band has earned a reputation as one of the most captivating acts on the contemporary music scene.
Polyrhythmics emerged from the rich creative soil of Seattles eclectic music community, releasing their self-titled debut album in 2011. Since then, their discography has grown to include fan-favorite albums such as Octagon (2015), Caldera (2017), Man from the Future (2020), and Life From Below (2025). Each release showcases their fearless exploration of genre boundaries and their commitment to crafting vibrant, deeply textured soundscapes.
Last years Life From Below marked an exciting chapter for Polyrhythmics, delivering a fresh collection of grooves infused with the bold creativity and signature tight-knit musicianship that fans have come to expect. The band reflects on over a decade and a half of musical evolution, countless miles on the road, and a loyal community of listeners that continues to grow.
Over the years, Polyrhythmics have graced stages at major festivals and renowned venues across the United States and internationally, sharing bills with legendary artists while carving out a distinct space in the global funk and soul scene. Their music - equal parts danceable, thoughtful, and immersive - offers a rich listening experience that draws from the roots of American funk and soul while incorporating global influences.
As Polyrhythmics continue their journey, they remain committed to pushing boundaries, creating new grooves, and bringing their celebrated live energy to audiences around the world.

About West Coast Mash
A stylistically unique band from day one, the members of West Coast Mash are as eclectic as their sound. The band didnt necessarily form themselves; they were brought together through a chain of interesting events that inspired them to create music deeply rooted in their individual life experiences.
Their creative process begins with honest reflection on where theyve been and where life is taking them. The songs of West Coast Mash arent created outside of themselves-they are born from lived experiences. A musical tapestry of life, joy, hope, sorrow, angst, and exhilaration, their music resonates with listeners through its authenticity and emotional depth.
Blending influences of rock, funk, blues, and folk rock, West Coast Mash channels a sound that is both soulful and powerful. Their belief is simple: there is no greater sound than the sound of honesty. Through their original music and dynamic performances, they invite audiences to listen not just with their ears, but with their hearts.

description: Blending gritty rock, blues, and soul with powerhouse vocals and heartfelt lyrics, Sons of Legion takes the stage at the EQC Event Center on Sunday, October 4 for the Soul to Sol World Tour!
big_desc:

Get ready for an unforgettable night of powerful vocals, soul-stirring lyrics, and high-energy rock at the EQC Event Center on Sunday, October 4.
Born from a chance encounter between two musicians from opposite coasts, Sons of Legion (SØL) is the embodiment of serendipity in sound. This dynamic duo chose to walk the same musical path, creating a unique blend that defies geographical boundaries and genre constraints.
At its core, Sons of Legion is a powerhouse of rock n soul, seamlessly fusing the raw, unbridled energy of rock with the deep, emotive currents of blues and the timeless allure of soul. Their sound is a delicate balance of rugged grit and sophisticated class, evoking memories of rocks greatest legends while carving out a distinct identity all their own.
Known for their electrifying performances and thought-provoking lyrics, Sons of Legion has built a reputation that resonates far beyond their Nashville roots. Their music speaks to the heart and ignites the spirit, with tracks like "Brand New Day," "Power," and "Firestarter" serving as testaments to their songwriting prowess.
The bands impact extends well beyond the stage. With nearly 1.8 million monthly listeners on Spotify, Sons of Legion has found its way into the mainstream consciousness. Their music has become the soundtrack to pivotal moments, featured on ESPN broadcasts, Dodge Ram commercials, Netflix productions, and NBC programming.
As Sons of Legion continues to evolve and push boundaries, they remain true to their ethos of authenticity and musical integrity. Each note, each lyric, each performance is a reflection of their journey - two paths converged, creating a musical force that continues to inspire and captivate audiences worldwide.
Dont miss your chance to see one of todays fastest-rising rock and soul acts live.

About Seattles Tribute to the Music of Tom Petty
Petty Thief has been rocking the greater Pacific Northwest for going on 20 years now. A no-frills rock band from the greater Seattle area that doesnt wear silly wigs or funny-looking hats to "authenticate" their shows. They provide a heartfelt, passionate tribute to the music of Rock and Roll Icon, Tom Petty.
Conceived at a Halloween party at the Rocksport Bar and Grill in West Seattle in 2007, Petty Thief plays all the big hits you know and love like, American Girl, Free Falling, I wont back down, The Waiting, Breakdown, Mary Janes Last Dance and many more big hits, but they also dive into the lesser played nuggets like Even the Losers, Crawling back to you, Rebels, Cabin down below, Change of Heart, Kings Highway and many more. They even dip into the catalogs of The Traveling Wilburys and Mudcrutch!
When asked why they didnt take the impersonation or prop-driven approach, founder Andy Volmer says, "We wanted to approach the tribute band genre as a true live rock and roll band, not a novelty act, and we really feel that we have what no one else has - the most authentic and genuine sounding Tom Petty experience in the Pacific Northwest."
Website:
http://www.pettythiefrocks.com
About Reckless (A Tribute to Bryan Adams)
Formed in 2017, and hailing from the Great Pacific Northwest city of Seattle, WA, "Reckless" is a 6-piece tribute to the music of Canadian Rocker, Bryan Adams. True to his sound and style, they pack a 90-minute set with hits like Cuts like a Knife, Heaven, Somebody, Heat of the Night, Lonely Nights and countless others. Veteran Seattle musicians give life to his catalogue, with decades of experience between them. Take a trip back to the heyday of MTV with one of Canadas finest exports and relive your Summer of 69!
Reckless is:
John Comstock - Lead Vocals
Scotty Donaldson - Lead Guitar
Andy Volmer - Rhythm Guitar/Vocals
John Paredes - Keyboards/Vocals
Jim Savery -Bass Guitar
Tate Erickson - Drums

About Six Gun Rebels (Bad Company tribute)
Six Gun Rebels live production of Bad Companys greatest hits preserves the image, sound, and stage persona of 70s era Bad Company. Audiences are amazed at the accuracy of our live retrospective journey through such Bad Company songs as Cant Get Enough - Feel Like Makin Love - Shooting Star - Rock and Roll Fantasy - Frees All Right Now - and many more! They have performed in front of hundreds of people at casinos, theaters, and other music outlets across the western United States.
About Rockfish and Friends
Former KISW/KZOK radio personality Rockfish is back with 5 new friends and a fresh set of "classic rock cuts thatll kick your butt".
Known for writing and recording "Twisted Tunes" for Radio Hall-of-Famer Bob Rivers, Rockfish took to the live stage in 2006 with his band, Rockfish And Friends.
Since that time, he has fronted the "Chicago Tribute Authority", participated in the successful "Georgefest" concert series and most recently, established MILLER TIME (A tribute to the music of the Steve Miller Band). On top of it all, he continues to be the lead singer of Whiskey River "Americas #1 Lynyrd Skynyrd Tribute".
Having built their reputation on performing the songs that no one else will, Rockfish And Friends are back with even more "obscure" rock classics that will not only jog your musical memory, but have you "Dancing in the Moonlight".
Youll walk away from an R.A.F. show whistling songs you havent heard in years, even if you never learned to whistle.
Rest assured no other bands in the Puget Sound are playing songs like these...they simply wouldnt dare.

Mike Mattingly (Boy Toy/Herding Cats/Georgefest) - Guitar/Vocals

About South Sound Blues Association Holiday Party
The annual South Sound Blues Association Holiday Party is returning to the Spanish Ballroom on Sunday, December 6, from 5-9pm. The evening will feature musical performances by the Ben Rice and the PDX Hustle and Mark Dufresne and Billy Stapleton.
About Ben Rice and the PDX Hustle
A three-time Blues Music Award nominee, Ben Rice has built a reputation as one of the most expressive and versatile artists in todays roots and blues scene. While he began in traditional blues, over the years hes expanded his sound with soul, R&B, folk, and country influence to connect with an ever-growing audience.  Fans are equally drawn to his heartfelt songwriting, evocative vocals, and dynamic guitar work. In 2023, Ben unveiled a bold new chapter with his horn-driven ensemble, Ben Rice & The PDX Hustle. With its blend of horns, vocal harmonies, piano and organ, the group captures the raw energy of Rices original music and delivers it with a commitment and drive that has been igniting audiences across the Pacific Northwest and beyond.
About  Mark Dufresne and Billy Stapleton
The duo of vocalist/harmonica player Mark Dufresne and guitarist Billy Stapleton features two of the most recognizable and highly regarded figures on the Pacific Northwest blues scene. Each has won multiple awards from the Washington Blues Society and has been inducted into their Hall of Fame. Mark Dufresne toured the world as a member of the band Roomful of Blues, and is known for his rich, three octave tenor voice. Billy Stapleton is a wizard on both conventional and slide guitar and has played with and led multiple blues and rock bands over the past four decades.

About Tacoma’s Chinese Expulsion of 1885
On November 3, 1885, five hundred white
Tacomans rounded up hundreds of the citys remaining Chinese residents and
forcibly marched them through the pouring rain to a railroad station and
crammed them into boxcars bound for Portland. 
After terrorizing local businessmen known to be supporters of the Chinese,
this mob burned Tacomas Chinatown to the ground. The mob was so methodical in
its expulsion of Chinese residents, local newspapers reported, that its
approach was hailed as the "Tacoma Method."
Tacomas Chinese Expulsion was the dark culmination of national and local
anti-Chinese sentiment, numerous outbursts of violence in the Puget Sound
region, and a culture within the city of Tacoma that reinforced xenophobia and
an enduring nativism.  The terrorism in
Tacoma dehumanized an immigrant population and stimulated expulsions of Chinese
communities in over two hundred West Coast and Northwest towns and cities
between 1885 and 1887.
History Professor Dr. Dearinger concentrates
on the ways Tacoma s Chinese Expulsion was depicted in the late 1880s and how
the city reckoned with its anti-Chinese history in the generations that
followed, leading to the creation of Chinese Reconciliation Park.
Dr. Ryan Dearinger is Professor of History
and Faculty Fellow in the Honors College at George Fox University, where he
teaches courses on the American West, labor and working-class history, and
immigration. His book
The Filth of Progress: Immigrants, Americans, and the
Building of Canals and Railroads in the West
won the 2017 "Best Book Award"
from Phi Alpha Theta, the National History Honor Society.  His current book project explores the history
of Tacomas 1885 Chinese Expulsion.
About History Pub
Enjoy 15% off your hotel stay on History Pub nights! Show your ticket at check-in.
These events are open to
everyone interested in Pacific Northwest
history, and beyond! Often co-sponsored by local or state historical and civic organizations, we
bring you experts, scholars, first-person experiencers, historians and documentaries expounding on topics from indigenous history to the birth of Portland, early explorers
to hop growing, and on and on! Its like being
back in the classroom - except this time you get to settle into comfortable
seats and enjoy a drink or two with dinner while you listen and learn.

About Tanner Laws Band
Born and raised in Thompson Falls, deep in the mountains of Western Montana, Tanner Laws grew up around the things that make country music worth writing: steep mountains, wide valleys, rolling hills, hard winters, rodeos, rivers, and the kind of people who mean what they say. He studied Civil Engineering at Montana Tech - and was good at it - but the songs kept coming, and eventually the songs won.
Tanner spent years building his craft the honest way: playing bars, rodeos, and dance halls across Big Sky Country before forming the Tanner Laws Band in 2024. The lineup reads like a strange and perfect accident - jazz majors from the University of Montana handling drums and bass, a software engineer pulling double duty on electric guitar and pedal steel, a killer fiddle player holding the high lonesome end, and a former engineer up front with a voice built for the wide open spaces he writes about. In their first year together, they were named Missoulas Best New Band.
The sound theyve landed on is rooted in country and folk storytelling - influenced by Alan Jackson, Keith Whitley, and the Turnpike Troubadours. These are songs about hunting and fishing, about losing and learning, about the specific kind of pride that comes from a place most people only drive through. Theres fiddle and pedal steel up front, a rhythm section that can swing a dance floor, and lyrics that sound like they were earned rather than written.
The band hit the road immediately and hasnt slowed down - opening for the Turnpike Troubadours, Clint Black, Colby Acuff, Gary Allan, Rodney Atkins, Corey Kent, Braxton Keith, Dustin Lynch, Sam Barber, and others, while racking up Northwest CMA awards for Songwriter of the Year, Male Vocalist of the Year, and Favorite Local Solo Artist. Theyve played the Miles City Bucking Horse Sale, the Calgary Stampede, countless rodeos and county fairs, and listening rooms from Montana to Atlanta.
Tanner Laws isnt waiting on Nashville to discover him. Hes building something real, in his own backyard, for the people who actually live the life he sings about.

About The Gothard Sisters
The Gothard Sisters, Greta, Willow, and Solana, are a contemporary Celtic folk trio from the Pacific Northwest whose music blends Celtic, folk, classical, world, new-age, and Americana influences. Multi-instrumentalists and songwriters, they bring their stories to life with layered violin work, guitar, mandolin, bodhrán, djembe, whistle, and tight sibling harmonies, highlighting careful attention to arrangement and melodic detail.
Raised in an artistic, nature-filled environment, they studied classical music while exploring folk traditions, developing a sound that is vivid, imaginative, and rooted in storytelling. They have released 11 albums, performed over 2,000 shows, and earned more than
70 million global streams, reflecting the broad appeal of their music to listeners of all ages and backgrounds. Their newest album, Moment in Time, continues to showcase their blend of narrative, melody, and acoustic craftsmanship. They write and record near their home, drawing inspiration from traditions and landscapes from around the world.

About True Loves
The Seattle-based, original instrumental funk & soul group True Loves began in 2014 as a jam session between drummer David McGraw, bassist Bryant Moore and guitarist Jimmy James, and has  sinced blossomed into a global force featuring percussionist Iván Galvez, trombonist Greg Kramer, and saxophonists Gordon Brown and Skerik. Together, the groups live performances and albums have garnered them much acclaim and millions of streams on YouTube.
In 2017, True Loves recorded their debut instrumental album, Famous Last Words, receiving worldwide adulation. The band released their sophomore album, Sunday Afternoon, in 2021. 2024 saw the release of the single "Good Weed and Red Wine" featuring keyboardist Nigel Hall (Lettuce) followed by a second European tour. Another single, "Dopus no. 1," was released as the B-side on a vinyl 7 inch. True Loves returned to Europe in the fall of 2025 and supported legendary band Ghost Note on their return to the US. The band is at work on their next album with US and European tours planned.
About Velocity
Velocity is a high-energy instrumental jazz fusion band from Tacoma, Washington. Formed in 2011, the group blends modern jazz with funk and progressive rock, combining hard-hitting grooves, strong melodic hooks, shifting time signatures, and open improvisation. Inspired by artists such as Weather Report and Chick Coreas Elektric Band, Velocity creates music that is adventurous and technically demanding while remaining groove-driven and accessible.
The band features Peter Adams on keyboards, Cliff Colón on saxophone, Brian Smith on drums, Rob Hutchinson on bass, and Mason Hargrove on guitar. Over more than a decade together, Velocity has recorded four albums of original and reimagined material, earning recognition throughout the Pacific Northwest. KNKXs The New Cool named Magnetar among its favorite albums of 2019, and Quantum Christmas was nominated for Northwest Recording of the Year in the 2023 Earshot Jazz Golden Ear Awards.
With a sound built around rhythmic interplay, energetic improvisation, and the chemistry developed over years of playing together, Velocity brings a distinctly modern, groove-driven approach to jazz fusion.

About What’s Up with the Pacific Northwest and Serial Killers?
In the 1970s, 80s, and 90s, the Pacific Northwest was the origin of some of the countrys worst serial killers. Ted Bundy. Gary Ridgway. Robert Yates. David Berkowitz. Could it be the rain and dark skies? The possibly too convenient I-5 corridor from California to Canada? What about the Tacoma smelters that once emptied tons of lead emissions into the air? True crime author Rebecca Morris investigates the notorious cases of these and other killers, justice sought for the victims, their commonality, differences, and the unsolved mysteries of our region.
Author Rebecca Morris spent many years in broadcast and print journalism in New York City, Portland, and Seattle. She is a New York Times bestselling author of nine true crime books and a crime expert, having appeared on numerous television programs and documentaries. Rebecca lives in Seattle, teaches writing workshops at the Seattle Public Library, and mentors new authors.
About History Pub
Enjoy 15% off your hotel stay on History Pub nights! Show your ticket at check-in.

everyone interested in Pacific Northwest

About Xolie Morra & The Strange Kind
Xolie Morra & The Strange Kind  fuses classic rock, country and pop to form a unique grey matter that is their own distinct sound.  Over the majority of their musical journey, Xolie and the band have shared the same stage with musical acts such as Sarah McLachlan, Crosby Stills & Nash,  Brandi Carlile, John Mayer and many more.  Their TEDxTalk titled "Autism and the Language of Music" is a window into the mind and methods behind the music.  Xolie prides themself in being an open book, using music to tell a story about all things from a Xolie perspective.
Music can be found on all major music streaming services.
Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Threads
@TheStrangeKind
About Trashasaurus Rex
Trashasaurus Rex is a female fronted, feminist, queer, original rock band hailing from Tacoma/Federal Way. Formed from an impromptu school carpool drop off conversation between Allysa (vocals) and Grace (drums), the band quickly grew to include Divya (bass) and Dave (guitar). Trashasaurus Rex has played from Olympia to Seattle and is recording their first EP! The band delivers a captivating performance with melodic, unfiltered vocals and catchy riffs.
About Flytrap
Flytrap, is a energetic impactful band from Shelton WA. They mix genres like shoe-gaze, alternative rock, grunge, with sad melodic lyrics to create their own unique sound. Flytrap members are all in high-school but they play like they have been doing it for years. They are working on a 4 song EP that will release on all music platforms in the next couple of months. With the support from friends, family, and fans Flytrap thrives.
About The Proffits
Through the boarded up windows and deadbolted doors of a former mortuary, something stirs. Its not ghosts, but the rumble of The Proffits tearing through another practice, loud enough to rattle hubcaps of the cars across the street in the parking lot. Fierce vocals distort over a bassline that rumbles beneath surf-drenched guitar and pounding drums.
The Proffits are Olympia, WAs answer to a question nobody asked but everyone needed. Surf punk at its trashiest and most familiar, they channel the sleaze of The Cramps, the raw chaos of The Sonics, and flirt with the soul-scratched swagger of the Detroit Cobras. Their songs dont just haunt, they move, with melodies and arrangements that summon hips into motion and boots onto beer-stained floors or cemetery plots.
